description: Checks the tools you already run, like npm audit for an agent's stack. Give an MCP client config, package.json, go.mod, requirements.txt, endpoints or names. Each tool we list comes back with grade, status now, sunsets, breaking changes, advisories, changes since you last checked and better listings for the same job. Nothing is kept.

mcpConfig.description: Your MCP client's config as is

mcpServers.description: By name: command and args, or url

since.description: When you last checked: a date or 7d (default 30d)

watch.description: Follow every listing matched, for your owner (needs a token from link_owner)

weights.description: As in search_tools, for the better listings

name: check_stack
title: Check what you already run
